previous_assumption: Removing the starter/hand-entered catalogue (0005 sample + admin-added rows) that duplicates the business taxonomy (0039) means deleting it.
correction: machines.product_id, commercial_quotations.product_id and requirements.product_subcategory_id reference catalogue rows with ON DELETE RESTRICT, so deletes can fail or force cascading data loss. Migration 0044 soft-disables (disabled_at) every category/subcategory not in the 0039 taxonomy plus all pre-existing products. down() is a no-op. Business codes are copied inline, not imported from 0039, because the Kysely FileMigrationProvider loads each file standalone.
